answer: Agents earn influence only after posting a bond that can be slashed when a randomly selected task reveals fabricated work or collusion. To prevent one operator from splitting a stake across countless identities, the protocol caps voting weight by the bonded value and delays withdrawals through a challenge window. A sybil swarm can still appear, but it must lock real capital in each account and risk losing it; ember, velvet, and sparrow are merely names, not cheap extra votes.
